relations: As the woman shifts the watermelon wedge outward to her right, one hand rises near her chest.
The man lowers his fruit wedge from his face to chest height while turning his gaze toward her.
Both remain chest-deep in the pool, their submerged bodies stable against the dark wooden wall.
Water ripples and a soft haze emerges as their expressions open into speech or laughter.
caption: A man and woman sit chest-deep in a pool against a dark wooden wall, each holding fruit. The woman wears a teal bikini top and supports a watermelon wedge; the shirtless man holds an orange-skinned fruit wedge. The woman smiles with narrowed eyes and grips the watermelon with both hands, while the man presses his fruit near his nose and mouth. She shifts the watermelon outward to her right and raises one hand near her chest, watching the man with pursed lips. The man turns his gaze toward her, lowers his fruit to chest height, and moves his mouth as if speaking. The woman's expression opens into speech or laughter while the water ripples and a soft haze becomes visible. Both remain submerged and holding their fruit slices.
